answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 90 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a cipher bet on surviving 90 epochs of grading, and every nectar settlement recomputes the bridge schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
